text:
sanjay: heads up — noticed a p95 decode latency jump in canary after last night's merge (merge: 2f4b9c7). short sequences (<= 32) are worst hit, ~1.8x p95. logs + perf traces here: https://redwood.internal/perf/4242 :eyes:

alex: looking. can reproduce locally on canary stack (gpu-small). quick flamegraph shows extra memcopy in attention path after kernel selector change. attaching snippet:
```
attn_kernel: fused-attn-v2 (selected)
memcopy_kv: 0.42ms (was 0.06ms)
decode_tail: +0.9ms
```

maria: confirmed. selector heuristic flipped on shortseq warmup. selector now prefers a fused kernel that has higher setup cost but better throughput — bad for short tails. cc @olivia for rollout decision.

olivia: canary metrics show user-facing error is just latency, no correctness regression. we should avoid full rollback unless we can't patch quickly. options: revert merge, tweak selector threshold, or add shortseq override to force previous kernel.

jamie: I pushed a quick reproducer + perf test to my branch. runs: `bazel test //perf:shortseq_decode --runs_per_test=10` — baseline vs post-merge diff attached.

alex: bisect points to commit 2f4b9c7 -> `kernel-selector: prefer fused when est_tokens>16` — bug is threshold logic treating warmup KV size as est_tokens. shortseq with KV warmup looks like est_tokens>16.

maria: minimal patch suggestion: change selector to use "effective_seq_len" instead of est_tokens and add a 12-token hysteresis for short tails. i'll open PR with tests.

jamie: can we hotfix in canary and run traffic for 2 hours? if p95 drops back to baseline we can promote. otherwise revert.

deploy-bot: deploy started for `eng-runtime/hotfix/selector-shortseq` — build 4242.ETA 12m

alex: quick profiling after hotfix build (local): p95 back within 5% of baseline on shortseq. ran `perf/shortseq_decode` 20 runs.

olivia: ok plan: hold canary, run A/B for 2h on small % traffic. if stable, promote. keep rollback ready. maria owns PR, alex to monitor perf dashboards, jamie to run e2e.

maria: PR: https://redwood.internal/pulls/eng-runtime/1872 — patch + unit + perf test. added changelog note.

jamie: running e2e load now, sending summary in 30m.

alex: also added a quick probe metric to surface kernel-choice distribution by seq_len so we don't miss this class again.

deploy-bot: canary deploy successful (4242) — traffic routed: 1% -> canary.

jamie: initial 30m looks good, p95 down to usual. leaving monitoring for the next 90m.

sanjay: thanks all — great triage. follow up items: (1) promote hotfix if stable, (2) add regression test to CI perf, (3) dashboard alert for kernel-choice anomalies.
